name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 48 – Am 31
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 48a. Calls for the next MFF to prioritise investments in smart electricity grids, storage, interconnections, collective self-consumption and renewable energy communities, in order to contribute to the structural reduction of energy costs for households, public authorities, farmers, SMEs and energy-intensive industries, while strengthening the Union’s energy autonomy and accelerating the integration of renewable energy into the internal energy market;
